job_title: Gauteng Dept of Health: Nursing Traineeship Programme 2027
about_role:
Location: Gauteng
Applicants are invited to apply to the Gauteng College of Nursing to study towards the Diploma in Nursing in 2027 at one of the College campuses: • Ann Latsky Campus • Chris Hani Baragwanath Campus • SG Lourens Campus • Bonalesedi Campus.
To successfully apply and be considered for the training, please take note of the following:
• You are required to register a profile on the system before you can apply.
• Must be a South African citizen, who resides in the Gauteng Province.
• You must be in possession of one of the following school leaving certificates – a Senior Certificate, a National Senior Certificate, currently in Grade 12 or National Vocational Certificate Primary Health
• Applications must be done on the GPG Professional Job Centre system before or on the 26th September;NO late applications will be accepted
• Documents will be uploaded on the system, however you will be required to take supporting documents to the selection centre should you be shortlisted.
• No hand delivered or emailed applications will be accepted, all applications must be done online.
The following subject criteria are required:
• Senior Certificate: English HG D or SG C, Biology HG D or SG C, Mathematics HG D or SG C and an M score of 17
• National Senior Certificate: English Level 4, Life Sciences Level 4, Mathematics Level 4 or Maths Literacy Level 5, and an APS of 27 or more (Life Orientation counts half the score)
• National Vocational Certificate: 50% in Fundamental Subjects (English First Additional Language, Maths/Maths Literacy, Life Orientation) and 60% in the Vocational Subjects (SA Health Care System, Public Health, The Human Body and Mind and Community Oriented Primary Care)
• Current Grade 12 learners must meet the National Senior Certificate requirements in their Grade 11 final results.
COMPETENCIES AND ATTRIBUTES:
Passion for nursing, Problem-solving ability • Patience • Ability to relate to people • Organisational ability • Leadership ability • Flexibility • Calmness during a crisis • Communication, numeracy and life skills • Computer literacy • Study skills • Honesty • Compassionate and caring.
NOTES:
All short-listed applicants will undergo a compulsory psychometric assessment. Successful applicants on psychometric assessment will be required to undergo medical surveillance, including a physical examination and verification of all documentation.
Applicants are required to scan and upload their Senior/National Senior/ National Certificate (Vocational) or statement of Grade 12 results or final Grade 11 results. Candidates can apply via the following link: https://nursingintake.gauteng.gov.za. Completion of all processes during the recruitment and selection process does not guarantee final selection on the programme.
Successful applicants will be required:
• To sign an agreement with the Gauteng Department of Health ,
• Attend lectures. Be prepared to participate in Work Integrated Learning (WIL) which includes shifts and working on public holidays, weekends and nights in Gauteng Department of Health hospitals and clinics as part of the program requirements.
PLEASE NOTE:
• Ensure that you qualify and meet the minimum requirements before you apply you do not receive feedback within 3 months after the closing date, please accept that your application was unsuccessful.

about_role:
Location: Johannesburg
We are seeking talented students to join our team for a 12-month P1 / P2 programme within our Service, Engineering, and Reliability functions in Johannesburg, South Africa.
The programme develops trainees from foundational learning to practical technical and operational competence in maintenance environments. It incorporates key Reliability and Industrial Engineering principles to enhance efficiency, equipment performance, and productivity, supported by structured training, assessments, and logbook completion to enable a smooth transition to value-adding work.
What the program offers:
• Exposure to both workshop and field service environments
• Gradual development from foundational learning to applied technical capability
• Integration of Mechanical and Industrial Engineering principles
• Hands-on involvement in maintenance, equipment reliability, and performance improvement
• Introduction to workflow optimisation, process efficiency, and continuous improvement
• Supported through formal training, on-the-job learning, mentorship, and structured assessments/logbooks
What you will gain from joining this program:
• Strong technical aptitude and hands-on experience in mechanical systems, tools, inspections, and diagnostic processes.
• Advanced problem-solving and analytical skills for troubleshooting and fault diagnosis.
• High level of safety awareness aligned with health, safety, and environmental standards.
• Key professional strengths including attention to detail, quality focus, teamwork, communication, and continuous learning.
• Apply theoretical knowledge in practical, real-world environments
• Demonstrate safe, compliant, and effective work practices
• Perform maintenance tasks with increasing independence and confidence
• Contribute to operational efficiency, equipment reliability, and successfully complete all assessments/logbooks
To be successful in this role you will need the following:
• Strong willingness to learn, grow, and improve continuously
• Proactive problem-solving mindset with ability to work effectively in teams and engage with technical staff
• High level of attention to detail with commitment to following procedures and maintaining quality standards
• Demonstrates accountability, discipline, reliability, and strong communication skills, including openness to feedback
Education/ Experience
• B-Tech (theory) in Mechanical or Industrial Engineering from a South African university
• Must require and be registered for P1/P2 in-service training to complete qualification
• Strong interest in mechanical systems, maintenance, and field service environments
• Basic technical understanding (advantageous) with a clear commitment to safety, quality, and continuous learning

expectations.

initiatives.

• Does not own day-to-day EUC/endpoint operations (Intune/MECM) or IAM

We are seeking a highly skilled Analytical Specialist to lead our analytical operations and manage the complete lifecycle of laboratory equipment. This is a hands-on expert role responsible for the precision, maintenance, and certification of high-end instrumentation (GC-MS, HPLC, etc.) within the FMCG (HPC) and specialty chemical manufacturing sectors. You will ensure that every raw material—from surfactants like SLES and LABSA to complex polymers—is deconstructed and verified against strict product specifications.
Key Responsibilities:
• Equipment Lifecycle Management: Act as the primary custodian for all laboratory assets. This includes coordinating professional servicing, managing internal and external calibration schedules, and ensuring all equipment maintains valid ISO/IEC 17025 or relevant industry certifications.
• Advanced Analytical Testing: Lead the deconstruction of complex chemical formulations using GC-MS and HPLC. You must be able to "fingerprint" incoming raw materials and finished products to ensure they meet exact chemical profiles.
• Method Development & SOPs: Independently develop, validate, and document new analytical test methods. You will write and maintain all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to ensure repeatability and data integrity across the lab.
• Maintenance & Troubleshooting: Perform routine preventative maintenance (e.g., cleaning ion sources, replacing GC liners) and provide high-level troubleshooting for instrument breakdowns to minimize downtime.
• Quality Compliance: Monitor measurement uncertainty and ensure all lab protocols align with global quality standards. You will lead technical preparations for internal and external quality audits. Required Qualifications & Experience:
• Education: BSc or MSc in Analytical Chemistry or Industrial Chemistry.
• Experience: 5–10 years of proven technical experience in an FMCG (HPC) or specialty chemical manufacturing laboratory.
• Instrumentation Mastery: Expert-level operation of GC-MS (including QQQ), HPLC, FTIR, and UV-Vis. Proficiency in chromatography data software (e.g., ChemStation, MassHunter) is essential.
• Chemical Knowledge: Deep understanding of the chemistry of HPC products (soaps, detergents) and intermediate raw materials like Polymers, LABSA, SLES, and Sodium Silicates.
• Certification Standards: Proven experience managing equipment in an ISO 17025 accredited environment, including maintaining meticulous calibration logs and traceability records.Additional Essential Skills:
• Reverse Engineering: Skilled in the "breakdown" of multi-component chemical mixtures to identify impurities or formulation shifts.
• Vendor Management: Experience liaising with instrument manufacturers and third-party service providers for specialized repairs and certifications.
• Safety Leadership: Expert knowledge of chemical hygiene, GHS labelling, and hazardous waste protocols specific to surfactant and polymer manufacturing.

With more than 34400 students, and approximately 1700 members of staff, the Durban University of Technology (DUT) is a leading university of technology proudly located in the beautiful cities of Durban and Pietermaritzburg, along the warm east coast of South Africa. Founded in April 2002 through the historic merger of the former ML Sultan Technikon and Technikon Natal, DUT has evolved into a modern, metropolitan, multi-campus university with roots tracing back to 1907.
Today, DUT is recognised nationally and internationally for its excellence in teaching and learning, research, innovation, entrepreneurship and engagement. A proud member of the International Association of Universities, DUT continues to expand its influence across South Africa and the world. In the 2025 Webometrics Rankings, DUT was ranked among the Top 6% of all universities and colleges worldwide, reflecting its academic excellence, research impact and strong global visibility.
DUT’s Philosophy of Education, “Our creativity and innovation shapes adaptive graduates who transform society” reflects the institution’s deep commitment to meaningful impact for societal transformation. Guided by its inspirational and aspirational ENVISION2030 strategy, which is rooted in DUT’s DNA of being ‘people-centred and engaged’ and ‘innovative and entrepreneurial’ and underpinned by its bespoke Living Values Framework, DUT focuses on ‘contributing to the improving lives and livelihoods’.

MAIN PURPOSE OF POSITION:
Manage the allocated debtors’ book by collecting payments on or before they are due and minimizing bad debts by following internal policies and procedures. Establish and maintain excellent relationships with all internal and external parties through constant communication. Work in line with credit legislation. Resolving account-related queries with a matter of urgency and maintaining an elevated level of customer service on all matters related to Accounts Receivable.
Credit Controller Duties and Responsibilities
Banking and Payment Allocations:
• Checking the various bank statements daily to identify payments made for the debtors assigned to the credit controller.
• Capturing the payment receipt on the ERP system.
• Allocating the payment according to the official remittance from the partner or an email from the partner advising which invoices to clear with the specific payment. Payments may NEVER be allocated from the oldest invoices forward UNLESS the credit controller has written confirmation from the Finance manager at the partner’s company.
• Save the payment batch in the specified folder for auditing purposes in line with the payment allocation process.
• If the credit controller has no remittance or instruction email on how to allocate the payment at the time the payment shows on the bank statement, the credit controller must phone and email the partner for the remittance or payment instructions. The credit controller will follow up on the remittance or payment instruction email daily for 2 days, and then the AR Supervisor must request the remittance or payment instruction email from the partner.
• If a remittance or payment instruction email is still not received on day 3 after the payment was received on the account, the credit controller will send a debtor’s aging ledger to the partner, marking which invoices will be cleared with the specific payment, and will then email it to the partner advising that allocation will take place accordingly. Payments allocated in this manner will not be reversed later when a remittance or payment instruction is received.Customer Statements:
• As soon as the Group Credit & AR Manager confirms all statements have been sent after month-end closure, the Credit controller will check System1A daily to ensure that the partners have viewed their statements.
• If the partner has not viewed their statement after the 3rd day, the credit controller will phone and email the partner to confirm the statement link was received and check if it was sent to junk mail or blocked.
• If the partner confirms that the statement has still not been received, the credit controller will resend a statement and ask the partner to confirm receiptInvoices, PODs, Credit notes, and Other Supporting Documents:
• The credit controller must send out Invoices, PODs, Credit notes, and all other supporting documents as and when required by the partner.
• The credit controller must then also educate the partner to use System1A so that they may access any required documents from that system in the future.
Recons:
• The credit controller must have an updated recons with full reasons for non-payment on EVERY account that has queries. This bank reconciliation must be ready and available to be sent to sales, the AR Supervisor, and or the Group Credit and AR Manager as needed.
• Collection process:
• The credit controller must phone each account on their assigned debtors book a minimum of 3 times:
• After the month-end statements are sent to ensure the statement was received and viewed.
• In the middle of the month to ask if there are any queries or issues to address before the month-end payment is due.
• The last week of the month to confirm the amount and date of payment for the payment that is due at the month's end, and to ensure that the payment is made so that it is in our bank on or before the last day of the month.
• It must be made clear to partners that we cannot allow late payments after payments are made.
• The credit controller must pull their age every Monday and work on it for the week by prioritizing the highest and oldest overdue accounts.
• These partners must be contacted once a week until their account is paid for in full
• The credit controller must also contact partners that have unapplied payments (and again remind the partner that this can be viewed on System1A) and or credit notes on their account, and ask the partner to either take back the payment or credits with their next payment or to advise the credit controller how to allocate
• Any unallocated cash (older than 6 months) and unallocated credits (older than 3 months) will be moved off the account.
• The credit controller must ask for the assistance of the sales team when collection efforts have been unsuccessful and ask them to arrange meetings with the partners to discuss the overdue payments, but the credit controller may never expect the salesperson to collect outstanding payments on their behalf.Monthly SPLA Order Process
• After the 8th working day of the new month, a report will be sent to the credit controller (Applicable to credit controllers dealing with Cloud partners) by the Cloud Partner Support team. The Credit controller then must urgently ensure that the following is done before the 15th working day of the new month for the business to release the partner’s SPLA orders:
• Overdue accounts – phone the partner and ask for immediate payment, advising we won’t be able to release their SPLA orders if their account is not paid up to date.
• The credit controller must also remind the partner of the 8% late reporting penalty from Microsoft or possible termination if we cannot release SPLA orders.
• Over-trading accounts - phone the partner and ask for immediate payment to bring their account into credit again, advising we won’t be able to release their SPLA orders if their account does not have sufficient credit limit.
• The credit controller must also remind the partner of the 8% late reporting penalty from Microsoft or possible termination if we cannot release SPLA orders.
• Insufficient credit limit accounts - phone the partner and ask for immediate payment to bring their account into credit limit again, advising we won’t be able to release their SPLA orders if their account does not have sufficient credit limit.
• The credit controller must also remind the partner of the 8% late reporting penalty from Microsoft or possible termination if we cannot release SPLA orders.
• The credit limit must also ask the Vetting team to apply for more cover with CGIC or motivate the Credit Committee to approve an internal lim-it to release the SPLA orders.Reporting On Overdue Accounts:
• The credit controller will receive a weekly Overdue feedback report from the Group Credit and AR Manager, whereby detailed feedback needs to be provided on the TOP 50 Overdue accounts for all the group companies.
• This feedback will be consolidated by the AR Supervisor and sent to the Group Credit and AR Manager no later than COB on Wednesday.Queries:
• The credit controller must log on to all Cloud-related queries as soon as they are identified on the JIRA query system.
• If the query is not resolved within 4 days, the credit controller must escalate to the AR Supervisor to address and must bring to the attention of the Group Credit and AR manager if any large accounts require specialized attention or are in a state of disarray.
• For all other queries, the credit controller must email the relevant product / brand team and copy the sales-person to assist with the resolution of the query. The credit controller must follow the standard escalation process until the query is resolved.

job_title: Accounts Clerk/ Creditors Clerk – Foreign Accounts
about_role:
To accurately process and maintain foreign supplier and international transaction accounts, ensuring timely payments, reconciliations, compliance with company policies, and adherence to foreign exchange and financial regulations. The role involves processing and reconciling foreign creditor accounts, capturing invoices and credit notes, and ensuring accurate allocation of payments. Day-to-day responsibilities include monitoring outstanding balances, assisting with credit control for foreign suppliers, and preparing reconciliations and reports for the finance team. The Accounts Clerk/Creditors Clerk will also manage cash transactions, support month-end closing activities, and maintain proper filing and documentation of all relevant accounting records. Collaboration with internal departments and external suppliers to resolve queries and ensure timely payments is an important part of this position.

Accounts Payable

• Investigate and resolve account variances and payment discrepancies.
• Reconcile foreign currency bank accounts as required.   Foreign Exchange Administration
• Record foreign currency transactions accurately.
• Daily capturing of credit notes on the system.
• FICA documentations collection
• Monitor exchange rate differences and assist with forex adjustments.
• Maintain records related to foreign payments and currency conversions. Financial Record Keeping
• Maintain accurate accounting records and supplier files.
• Capture transactions into the accounting system promptly.
• Ensure all documentation is filed and retained according to company procedures. Compliance & Reporting
• Ensure compliance with company financial policies and procedures.
• Assist with audit requests and provide supporting documentation.
• Prepare periodic reports on foreign accounts, payments, and outstanding balances. General Finance Support
• Assist with month-end and year-end closing activities.
• Support the Finance Department with administrative and accounting tasks.
• Provide excellent service to internal stakeholders and external suppliers.

• Supporting month-end finance processes and preparing information for review by management.

• Maintaining proper records, filing systems and administrative controls.
• Helping bring structure, discipline and reliability to the business’s finance and administration environment.

• A formal tertiary qualification in Finance, Accounting, Bookkeeping or a related field.

The IT Infrastructure Consultant is responsible for designing and tailoring IT infrastructure architectures that support public transport technology solutions. The role interprets solution-specific infrastructure standards and designs client-specific environments that meet system requirements as well as client operational, security, and performance needs. This position requires strong expertise in virtualization, cybersecurity, disaster recovery, high availability, networking, and hybrid/cloud infrastructure within mission-critical environments.
Key Responsibilities
Solution-Based Infrastructure Design
Design infrastructure architectures aligned with defined transport system requirements such as AFC, fare management, fleet management, RTPI, and control centre systems. Translate system infrastructure standards into client-specific designs. Assess client environments and identify gaps between existing infrastructure and solution requirements. Produce High-Level Designs (HLD) and Low-Level Designs (LLD) aligned with performance, availability, scalability, security, and integration requirements.
Client Environment Assessment
Conduct infrastructure assessments of client data centres, cloud platforms, and network environments. Evaluate compute, storage, virtualization, topology, and security posture. Identify risks, dependencies, and readiness gaps. Provide recommendations and remediation plans.
Architecture and Technical Expertise
Design virtualized server environments aligned with sizing requirements. Architect hybrid or cloud deployments where required. Ensure appropriate resource sizing for CPU, memory, storage, and IOPS. Design secure network architectures including segmentation, firewalls, and secure connectivity. Define high-availability, clustering, and redundancy strategies.
Security and Compliance
Ensure infrastructure aligns with cybersecurity best practices and transport authority standards. Incorporate identity management, encryption, endpoint protection, and network security controls. Support compliance with data protection and payment security standards such as PCI-DSS. Maintain awareness of emerging security threats and technologies.
Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity
Design Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity strategies aligned with RPO and RTO requirements. Implement backup, replication, and failover solutions. Ensure resilience levels for mission-critical systems. Participate in recovery testing and validation exercises.
Stakeholder and Pre-Sales Engagement
Provide infrastructure expertise during solution design and bid processes. Present architectures to technical and executive stakeholders. Support clarification of architecture requirements during implementation. Collaborate with software, implementation, and project teams.

job_title: Full-Time Remote Video Editor — AI Video Ads (Kling + AI Tools) for a US Ecommerce Brand
about_role:
FULL-TIME REMOTE VIDEO EDITOR — AI VIDEO ADS FOR A US ECOMMERCE BRAND
We are a US-based ecommerce company hiring full-time remote video editors to produce short video ads (30–60 seconds) for Facebook and Instagram. This is a long-term, permanent full-time position — we are looking for people who want stable work with one company, not a short project. We are hiring MORE THAN ONE editor for this role. Work is fully remote.
THE ROLE
You will receive a complete package for every ad: a finished script, a creative brief, and example videos showing the style to match. Your job is to turn that package into a finished video ad:
- Generate AI video clips using image-to-video tools (we use Kling via Higgsfield — we provide all accounts and all tools, you pay for nothing)
- Generate the starting images for those clips with AI image tools, using prompts you develop with our AI assistant
- Source real B-roll clips from TikTok, YouTube, and similar platforms where the shot calls for it
- Generate the voiceover with AI (ElevenLabs) from the provided script
- Assemble everything in the editing software you are most comfortable with (CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut, etc.): edit to the voiceover, add captions, add music, export
- Each ad is delivered as three versions with different openings (we will train you on our exact method — it is fast once learned)
You do not write scripts and you do not need marketing knowledge. We provide the script, the brief, and the reference videos. You provide clean, fast, good-looking execution. Work is assigned and tracked through a simple board — you always know exactly what to work on next.
SCHEDULE AND PAY
Full-time, 8 hours per day, Monday to Saturday. USD $600–$1,200 per month depending on experience, fixed, paid reliably every month. Real opportunity for pay growth as your output proves itself — we are building a long-term creative team and this role grows with the company.
HOW TO APPLY
Follow these instructions exactly. Applications that skip any step will not be read.
1. Start your application message with the word KINGFISHER on the first line.
2. Include a link to your portfolio or showreel.
3. List the AI video/image tools you have personally used and one sentence on what you made with each. If you have used Claude or another AI assistant, say so and tell us what for.
4. Confirm you are available full-time, Monday to Saturday, and are applying as an individual.
5. Answer this short exercise. Imagine you are producing a video ad from a script we gave you. Four situations come up. For each one, tell us which ONE action you would take and give one sentence explaining why.
a) One line of the script feels awkward to you and you think you could word it better. Do you: REWRITE IT / FLAG IT AND BUILD IT AS WRITTEN / SKIP THAT LINE?
b) The example video we gave you for style reference features a well-known influencer talking to camera. Do you: CLIP HER FOOTAGE INTO OUR AD / RECREATE THE SAME STYLE OF SHOT WITH AN AI-GENERATED PERSON / ASK US TO LICENSE HER FOOTAGE?
c) An AI-generated clip looks great except the person's hands are warped. Do you: SHIP IT, VIEWERS WON'T NOTICE / REGENERATE THE CLIP WITH A FIXED PROMPT / CROP THE HANDS OUT IF POSSIBLE, OTHERWISE REGENERATE?
d) You need a generic clip of a dog running in a park and can't find good free footage. Do you: LEAVE THAT SHOT OUT / GENERATE IT WITH AI / USE A CLIP THAT ALMOST FITS?
Shortlisted candidates will have a short video interview, and final candidates will complete a SHORT PAID test project (we pay you for it). We read every application that follows the instructions.

An well known insurance client is looking for a Senior Network and Security Engineer to join their team in Sandton, GP   who is comfortable working in a busy, security-critical enterprise environment and can take ownership of network, firewall, Azure connectivity, monitoring, and datacentre network operations. The role requires strong hands-on FortiGate experience, proven Extreme Networks switching knowledge, practical Azure networking exposure, and the ability to keep a regulated financial services environment stable, secure, well documented, and ready for incident response or disaster recovery scenarios.
Role Purpose:
This is a hands-on engineering role with responsibility across datacentres, core network infrastructure, firewall
operations, hybrid cloud connectivity, monitoring, incident response, maintenance, documentation, vendor
engagement, and continuous improvement of the network estate. The person must be able to operate independently, act as a escalation point, and provide practical guidance to junior engineers while maintaining clear communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Responsibilities:
1. Enterprise Networking
• Design, implement, support, and maintain LAN, WAN, WLAN, and datacentre network infrastructure.
• Support enterprise switching with a strong focus on Extreme Networks platforms.
• Configure and maintain VLANs, trunks, STP, redundancy, link aggregation, and resilient Layer 2 designs.
• Handle advanced routing and switching (OSPF, BGP, static routing, route redistribution, high availability failover).
• Troubleshoot performance, latency, packet loss, routing, STP, and connectivity issues.
• Act as an escalation point for complex network incidents and recurring issues.
• Contribute to network architecture decisions, standards, lifecycle refresh, and operational improvements.
2. Extreme Networks Switching
• Configure, troubleshoot, and maintain Extreme Networks switches in production and datacentre environments.
• Support switch stacks, chassis, edge, core, and aggregation layer configurations.
• Maintain resilient connectivity via trunking, link aggregation, STP tuning, redundant uplinks, and failover paths.
• Investigate switch port errors, interface utilisation, duplex/speed mismatches, VLAN mismatches, and MAC learning issues.
• Maintain consistent configuration standards and back up switch configurations.
• Support planned maintenance, firmware upgrades, configuration changes, and switch replacements.
3. Firewall and Network Security (FortiGate Essential)
• Configure, manage, and maintain FortiGate firewalls across the enterprise.
• Own firewall policy and rule management (rule creation, optimisation, cleanup, NAT, UTM profiles, security policies).
• Configure and troubleshoot VPN solutions (site-to-site, remote access, third-party, cloud connectivity).
• Monitor firewall health, logs, sessions, interface utilisation, VPN tunnels, and security events.
• Investigate and resolve firewall-related incidents affecting applications, users, systems, vendors, or cloud connectivity.
• Support firewall hardening, segmentation, least-privilege access, and policy governance.
• Support security audits, evidence gathering, compliance requirements, and remediation in a regulated financial services environment.
• Work with FortiManager and FortiAnalyzer for centralised policy management, reporting, logging, and visibility.
• Experience with IPS, IDS, SSL inspection, web filtering, application control, and security event investigation is advantageous.
4. Azure Networking and Hybrid Cloud Connectivity
• Demonstrate practical Azure networking knowledge (VNets, subnets, NSGs, route tables, Azure DNS, private connectivity, hybrid access).
• Support hybrid networking between on-premises infrastructure and Microsoft Azure.
• Troubleshoot Azure network routing, name resolution, firewall, NSG, private endpoint, and hybrid connectivity issues.
• Support Microsoft 365, Teams, Exchange Online, and Azure service connectivity from a firewall/network perspective.
• Work closely with cloud, server, security, and application teams to ensure secure, resilient, and well-documented cloud network architecture.
5. Monitoring, Alerting, and Observability
• Monitor network, firewall, wireless, cloud connectivity, and infrastructure health using enterprise tools.
• Investigate and resolve alerts related to availability, firewall health, interface utilisation, routing stability, VPN, wireless performance, and security events.
• Build, maintain, and improve dashboards, alert thresholds, operational reports, and health checks.
• Perform trend analysis and capacity planning to identify growth, availability, performance, and resilience risks.
• Maintain monitoring coverage for routers, switches, firewalls, wireless, VPNs, links, and cloud network services.
• Work with SNMP, syslog, ICMP checks, service checks, log forwarding, and alert escalation processes.
• Experience with Nagios is advantageous; exposure to PRTG, SolarWinds, Zabbix, FortiAnalyzer, FortiManager, or Azure Monitor is also valuable.
• Contribute to proactive monitoring improvements and service stability initiatives.
6. Wireless and Edge Networking
• Design, deploy, support, and troubleshoot enterprise WiFi (including high-density office environments).
• Support secure wireless authentication (WPA2, WPA3, 802.1x).
• Troubleshoot wireless performance, coverage, roaming, interference, and authentication issues.
• Maintain wireless standards, SSID configuration, guest access controls, and secure segmentation.
• Work with network access controls and secure edge access where applicable.
7. Datacentre, DR, and Resilience
• Support datacentre and DR network connectivity with a focus on availability, resilience, and failover readiness.
• Support redundant network paths, firewall failover, routing failover, VPN resilience, and DR network testing.
• Participate in change planning, maintenance windows, infrastructure refreshes, datacentre moves, and DR exercises.
• Assist with root-cause analysis, document lessons learned, and drive practical remediation actions.
8. Operations, Incident Response, and Collaboration
• Provide day-to-day support for network, firewall, wireless, VPN, and hybrid connectivity operations.
• Respond to incidents in a calm, structured, and methodical manner (especially during outages or security events).
• Participate in planned maintenance windows and after-hours support as required.
• Work closely with server, virtualisation, database, application, security, cloud, and service desk teams.
• Work with external vendors, ISPs, carriers, and technology partners to resolve incidents and deliver changes.
• Support change control, impact analysis, rollback planning, implementation plans, and post-change validation.
• Drive continuous improvement by identifying recurring issues and improving operational standards.
9. Documentation, Standards, and Knowledge Sharing
• Keep network and firewall documentation accurate and current (diagrams, IP ranges, VLANs, circuits, firewall rules, VPNs, configs).
• Maintain practical standards for network, firewall, monitoring, and Azure networking.
• Document operational procedures, runbooks, troubleshooting guides, and support handover notes.
• Share knowledge with junior engineers and contribute to a more mature infrastructure operations environment.
• Ensure configuration backups, change records, and operational documentation are kept up to date.

job_title: Wine Sales Specialist Consultant | Meridian Wine Merchants | Gauteng
about_role:
Meridian Wine Merchants is currently seeking a passionate and results-driven individual to join our team as a Wine Sales Specialist Consultant. At Meridian Wine Merchants, we expertly combine tradition and innovation to provide outstanding products tailored to our diverse clients. This position is based in Gauteng.
Duties and Responsibilities
• Identify, develop and convert new premium business opportunities while growing premium wine sales, profitability and portfolio performance across allocated territories.
• Develop annual customer growth plans, identify new premium opportunities, and implement initiatives that expand premium category sales.
• Execute wine list recommendations, premium portfolio placements, and listing opportunities within targeted customer segments and outlets.
• Proactively identify, prospect and convert new premium restaurants, hotels, hospitality groups and specialist wine customers within the allocated territory.
• Develop trusted long-term client relationships that position Meridian as the preferred premium wine partner while expanding customer value.
• Conduct customer-led trade visits to identify execution opportunities, customer requirements, visibility gaps, and portfolio growth opportunities.
• Lead premium tastings, winemaker dinners, customer events and educational experiences that generate new business opportunities and strengthen customer relationships.
• Develop customer-specific growth plans by identifying premium category opportunities, menu opportunities, new listings and premium portfolio expansion opportunities.
• Review customer wine offerings, identify gaps and growth opportunities, recommend commercially successful wine selections, and establish premium category standards.
• Gather and communicate customer insights, competitor activity, wine list trends, and regional market intelligence to support strategic commercial decisions.
• Identify new premium trading areas, emerging customer segments and untapped market opportunities for future business growth.
• Execute customer and portfolio segmentation strategies to ensure the right portfolio mix within the right customer environments.
• Execute cycle briefs, premium trade initiatives, promotional campaigns, and activation plans in conjunction with Trade Marketing and the Wine Specialist Manager.
• Work closely with Distribution, Trade Marketing, Key Accounts, Sales Reps, Finance, and internal support teams to ensure product availability and operational execution.
• Coach Sales Representatives on premium portfolio positioning, customer opportunities and premium selling techniques.
• Deliver premium wine education, food pairing guidance and category development sessions that strengthen customer capability and drive premium wine sales.
• Ensure disciplined usage and maintenance of Repforce, Truedata, reporting tools, and customer databases.
• Continuously maintain and improve wine, competitor, portfolio, commercial and premium category knowledge.
Requirements
• Grade 12 (Matric) plus Cape Wine Academy Wine Certificate
• Minimum 4+ years’ experience in FMCG liquor sales and merchandising across premium customer environments
• Basic proficiency in Microsoft Office; experience with CRM systems (e.g. Salesforce, CG Cloud) advantageous
• Valid driver’s licence, own reliable vehicle, and right to work in South Africa
Why Join Meridian?
Meridian Wine Merchants connects some of South Africa's most exciting premium wine brands with the country's leading restaurants, retailers, hotels and wine professionals. Every day is an opportunity to learn, grow and make an impact in an industry we're passionate about.
We're a team that works hard, celebrates success and is always looking for better ways to do things. We value people who bring energy, curiosity, integrity and a genuine love for wine. Here, your ideas matter, your contribution is recognised, and your growth is part of our success.
If you're passionate about premium wine, thrive in a fast-moving environment and want to build a career where you'll be challenged, supported and inspired every day, come and grow with us.

African Parks is a non-profit conservation organization that takes on the complete responsibility for the rehabilitation and long-term management of national parks in partnership with governments and local communities. We currently manage 23 national parks and protected areas in 13 countries covering over 20 million hectares in: Angola, Benin, Central African Republic, Chad, the Democratic Republic of Congo, Malawi, Mozambique, Republic of Congo, Rwanda, Zambia, Zimbabwe, South Sudan and Ethiopia.
The Great Nile Migration Landscape (GNML) in South Sudan spans over 120,000 km² across Badingilo and Boma National Parks, Jonglei State, and adjoining community lands. It forms one of Africa’s most important ecological systems, connecting the Sudd wetlands in the west to the Boma highlands in the east. The landscape supports extraordinary biodiversity, including the largest land mammal migration on earth comprising around 6 million animals.
JOB OVERVIEW:
The ICM is responsible for developing, in accordance with relevant African Parks SOPs
and in close collaboration with the AP ICPM, individual but linked information coordination functions for Boma NP, Jonglei Project and Bandigilo NP.
MAIN ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Set up, train and mentor the two teams in information collection and analysis techniques.
o Select and hire of both investigators and analysts.
o Assist during the basic training of both the investigators and analysts.
o Provide continued mentorship during the day-to-day work and operations of the teams in the four parks.
• Develop and maintain each park’s information coordination functions
o Focus analytical work and assure reporting standards
o Supervise collection/investigative efforts
• Supervise day-to-day work of park-level teams, including but not limited to work schedules, human resource requirements and personnel development, and other such activities as may be required or requested by the park manager.
• Ensure that the information coordination database is managed correctly and kept up-to-date.
o Ensure that all sensitive data is stored in a secure manner
• Develop and maintain relationships with other AP parks, key stakeholders, and partner organizations, including but not limited to those involved in security assessment and the investigation of wildlife crime-related matters.
• Assess material and equipment needs and lead procurement efforts for identified needs of all teams.
Academic & experience required.
1. Experienced working in information collection and/or information analysis required, preferably in a managerial role.
2. Experience with geographic information systems (GIS) and social network analysis (SNA) software.
3. Able to self-manage and understand priorities in a fast-paced environment.
4. Fluency in spoken and written English and ability to write detailed and accurate reports with clarity, brevity and timeliness.
5. Able to self-manage and understand priorities

• SEO strategy across a roster of US home service clients: what moves rankings, what's noise, what's next

Job Overview:
Are you energetic, ambitious, and looking to develop your career? Our Study Abroad department is looking to add a Debtors Clerk to their team. We offer a dynamic and challenging environment where we achieve our business objectives and have fun doing it.
We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Debtors Clerk to manage client debtor accounts and support the accurate and timely collection of outstanding amounts. The role will be responsible for invoicing, allocating receipts, reconciling accounts, following up on overdue balances, resolving debtor queries, and maintaining complete financial records. The successful candidate will work closely with the finance, advisory and operations teams to ensure that debtor information is accurate, payments are collected within agreed terms, and financial processes support a positive client experience.
You're perfect for this position if you:
• Have previous experience in a debtors, credit control, accounts receivable, bookkeeping or finance administration role.
• Understand debtor account reconciliations, payment allocations, invoicing and collection processes.
• Are confident working with Microsoft Excel, accounting systems and CRM platforms; experience with Xero is advantageous.
• Have excellent attention to detail and can maintain accurate, complete and confidential financial records.
• Communicate professionally and confidently with clients, colleagues and external partners.
• Are organised, reliable and able to manage competing deadlines independently.
• Are proactive, solutions-oriented and comfortable following up on outstanding payments.
• Can investigate discrepancies and resolve account queries efficiently.
• Maintain a high level of discretion, integrity and confidentiality. Your role and responsibilities:
Among other tasks, your main responsibilities will include:
Debtors administration and invoicing
• Managing and maintaining accurate debtor accounts for clients and other relevant payers.
• Preparing, checking and issuing invoices, credit notes and supporting documentation accurately and on time.
• Ensuring invoices reflect approved fees, payment terms and relevant contractual arrangements.
• Sending account statements and payment reminders in accordance with agreed collection procedures.
• Maintaining complete records of invoices, receipts, adjustments, correspondence and payment arrangements. Collections and account follow-up
• Monitoring outstanding balances and proactively following up on overdue accounts by email and telephone.
• Engaging professionally with clients to secure payment and agree appropriate payment arrangements where authorised.
• Escalating long-outstanding, disputed or high-risk accounts to management in line with internal procedures.
• Monitoring adherence to payment plans and following up immediately when agreed payments are missed.
• Providing clear updates to internal stakeholders on overdue accounts and collection activity. Receipting, allocation and reconciliations
• Verifying payments received and allocating receipts accurately to the correct debtor accounts and invoices.
• Reconciling debtor ledgers, bank receipts, CRM records and accounting system balances.

job_title: Performance Marketing Lead — Meta / Facebook Ads
about_role:
We're looking for an exceptional Meta media buyer who operates the way the best marketers will operate in 2026: with AI in the loop at every step. You'll own high-volume Facebook and Instagram campaigns end to end — strategy, creative production, launch, and optimisation — with aggressive CPA targets and real budget authority.
This is not a role for someone who dabbles with ChatGPT for ad copy. We want someone who has rebuilt their entire workflow around AI: driving campaign optimisation programmatically through the Meta Ads API and MCP-connected agents, generating and iterating video creative with AI tools in hours rather than weeks, and letting data — not habit — decide what runs.
What You'll Do
• Own high-volume campaigns — plan, launch, and scale Meta campaigns across multiple ad accounts, owning performance against tight CPA and ROAS targets.
• Optimise with AI in the loop — build and run agentic workflows (MCP servers, Meta Ads API, custom scripts, or tools like Claude) that monitor spend, surface anomalies, rotate creative, and execute budget and bid changes at a pace no manual buyer can match.
• Create video at speed — produce ad videos on the fly using AI video generation and editing tools (e.g. Runway, Veo, Sora, Kling, HeyGen, CapCut and similar), turning a creative brief into live test variants same-day.
• Handle editing and banner design — cut, caption, resize, and version video for placements; design static banners and image ads to a standard good enough to ship without a designer in the loop.
• Run a rigorous testing programme — structure high-tempo creative testing — hooks, formats, angles, audiences — and feed the results back into both the creative pipeline and the account structure.
• Stay on top of the data — own tracking, attribution (Pixel, CAPI, post-back), reporting, and the numbers behind every decision. You should be able to explain any account's performance from memory.
• Build the playbook — document what works, systematise it, and raise the bar for how the whole company buys media

Role Purpose
Our client is seeking a detail-oriented and customer-focused Short Term Claims Junior Assessor to support the accurate, fair, and timely assessment of homeowners' insurance claims. This role focuses exclusively on buildings and structural (non-motor) claims, ensuring that claims are assessed in accordance with policy terms, regulatory requirements, and internal claims standards.
Working closely with the Short Term Claims Team, the successful candidate will assist in evaluating claims, validating policy cover, gathering supporting information, and progressing claims efficiently while delivering exceptional customer service. This is an excellent opportunity for an individual looking to develop a career in short-term insurance claims assessment.
Key Responsibilities
Claims Assessment & Processing
• Assess allocated homeowners' insurance claims in accordance with policy terms, conditions, exclusions, and limits.
• Gather and verify all supporting documentation from policyholders, contractors, service providers, and internal stakeholders.
• Assess claims for indemnity, ensuring accurate application of excesses, policy conditions, and settlement calculations.
• Escalate complex, disputed, or high-value claims to senior assessors with clear supporting documentation.
• Process approved claims within delegated authority while maintaining compliance with internal controls.
Buildings & Structural Claims Support
• Conduct desktop assessments using photographs, contractor reports, repair quotations, and supporting documentation.
• Assist with site inspections under the guidance of senior assessors where required.
• Evaluate repair quotations and scope-of-work documents, identifying discrepancies or areas requiring further investigation.
• Assess common homeowners' claims including:
• Storm damage
• Fire damage
• Burst pipes
• Geyser failures
• Power surge claims
• Subsidence and structural damage
• Apply building and structural knowledge when evaluating claims and determining appropriate outcomes.
Fraud Identification & Risk Management
• Identify potential fraud indicators during the assessment process.
• Escalate suspicious claims promptly in accordance with company procedures.
• Verify supporting documentation and investigate inconsistencies where necessary.
• Promote fraud awareness through accurate claim validation and reporting.
Regulatory Compliance
• Ensure all claims comply with applicable Short-Term Policyholder Protection Rules (PPRs).
• Apply Treating Customers Fairly (TCF) principles throughout the claims process.
• Maintain complete, accurate, and auditable claim records.
• Ensure assessment decisions comply with company policies and regulatory requirements.
Customer & Stakeholder Engagement
• Provide professional and empathetic service to policyholders throughout the claims process.
• Keep customers informed of claim progress and manage expectations effectively.
• Liaise with brokers, contractors, suppliers, and internal Claims Consultants to facilitate claim resolution.
• Escalate complaints or customer concerns in line with internal procedures.
Continuous Learning & Development

• Keep up to date with policy wording changes, regulatory developments, and claims best practices.

Customer Interation -  Respond to customer inquiries via phone, email and online channels regarding required services and parts. Check & assist with reviewing internal costings leading to preparing customer quotations.

Liase with the workshop  regarding processing of Job cards/picking lists and production orders.

Role Purpose:
The Lending Dealmaker will be required to originate, structure, negotiate and execute profitable lending (Working Capital, Commercial Property finance and Term Loan) and structured finance transactions for mid-market corporate clients by developing trusted client relationships, identifying funding opportunities and coordinating internal stakeholders through to successful financial close.
The Transactor is accountable for the entire client lifecycle, from business development and opportunity identification through credit approval, execution, drawdown and ongoing portfolio management; while balancing client needs, commercial returns and prudent risk management
Main Accountabilities:
• Origination
• Originate and develop quality lending opportunities that align with Merchant West's strategic objectives, risk appetite and return requirements.
• Develop and maintain a sustainable pipeline of bankable transactions through proactive business development, referrals and relationship management.
• Identify, engage and convert new clients while deepening relationships with existing clients and strategic partners.
• Understand clients' funding requirements and develop bespoke financing solutions that create long-term value.
• Market, present and articulate credit opportunities to internal stakeholders, Credit Committees, institutional funders and other capital providers.
• Coordinate and manage the end-to-end transaction process from initial engagement through credit approval, documentation and funding.
• Prepare high-quality term sheets, transaction proposals, credit papers, investment memoranda, client presentations and other supporting documentation.
• Transaction Structuring
• Structure innovative and commercially viable financing solutions that balance client requirements with Merchant West's risk and return objectives.
• Develop funding structures suitable for institutional investors and other funding partners.
• Assess alternative financing structures and recommend the most appropriate solution based on commercial, legal, tax and funding considerations.
• Work collaboratively with Credit, Legal, Treasury and external advisers to optimise transaction structures and facilitate successful execution.
• Contribute to product development, process improvements and strategic initiatives as required.
• Transaction Execution and Portfolio Management
• Manage the successful implementation of approved transactions through close coordination with Credit, Legal, Operations, Treasury and external stakeholders.
• Ensure legal documentation accurately reflects approved commercial terms and all conditions precedent are satisfied prior to funding.
• Oversee transaction drawdown and successful financial close.
• Monitor the ongoing performance of the portfolio through financial reviews, covenant monitoring and proactive client engagement.
• Identify emerging credit risks and implement appropriate remedial actions where required.
• Maintain awareness of economic, industry and regulatory developments that may impact client performance and portfolio quality.
• Credit Evaluation & Assessment
• Conduct comprehensive commercial, financial and credit assessments of prospective transactions.
• Analyse historical and forecast financial information, cash flows, repayment capacity, management capability, industry dynamics and security structures.
• Identify key transaction risks and develop appropriate mitigants and structural protections.
• Prepare clear, balanced and well-supported credit recommendations for approval.
• Apply sound commercial judgement when evaluating pricing, risk-adjusted returns, return on equity (ROE), capital utilisation, portfolio concentration, correlation risk and overall transaction profitability.
• Relationship Management
• Develop and maintain trusted relationships with clients, introducers, institutional investors, professional advisers and internal stakeholders.
• Build a strong internal network across Origination, Credit, Legal, Treasury, Finance and Operations to facilitate efficient transaction execution.
• Act as a trusted adviser by developing a thorough understanding of clients' businesses, industries and strategic objectives.
• Deliver exceptional client service while maintaining an appropriate balance between commercial opportunity and prudent risk management.
• Represent Merchant West professionally, demonstrating the highest standards of integrity, accountability and collaboration..
Qualifications:
• Bachelor’s degree, Finance, Accounting, Economics or Commerce.
• Postgraduate qualification such as a CA(SA), CFA Charter, MBA or Master's degree in Finance, Business or a related field (advantageous).
Experience:
• 2 – 4 years in a lending and Dealmaker environment.
• Demonstrated experience in corporate banking, commercial banking, structured finance, leveraged finance, asset finance, private credit or business banking, with a proven ability to originate, structure and execute debt transactions.
• Demonstrated experience in corporate banking, commercial banking, structured finance, leveraged finance, asset finance, private credit or business banking, with a proven ability to originate, structure and execute debt transactions.
• Demonstrated experience in corporate credit and lending environments, including credit underwriting, financial statement analysis, cash flow forecasting and financial modelling, debt structuring and pricing, assessment of security and collateral arrangements, preparation and review of loan documentation (including term sheets, facility agreements, and security documentation), and negotiation of commercial and legal terms with clients, legal advisers, and other stakeholders
• Experience engaging directly with entrepreneurs, business owners, financial directors, accountants and professional advisers.
• Experience presenting transactions to Credit Committees and managing deals through approval, documentation and financial close.
• Experience within corporate credit, specialised finance, structured lending, commercial banking or private debt markets is highly advantageous.
• An established professional network capable of generating new business opportunities will be advantageous.
Skills:

• Credit analysis
• Valuation techniques

• Portfolio management

• Excellent time management skills
• Strong work ethic
• Commercial acumen
• Relationship building

• Entrepreneurial mindset
• Strategic thinking

job_title: Postdoctoral Research Fellowship: Wildlife Science, Wildlife Management and Conservation Biology (1-
about_role:
The Department of Animal Science at the University of the Free State (UFS), South Africa, invites applications for a Postdoctoral Research Fellowship in Wildlife Science, Wildlife Management and Conservation Biology.
Candidates interested in pursuing an academic or professional career in Wildlife Science, Wildlife Management, Conservation Biology, Rangeland Ecology, Wildlife Monitoring and Sustainable Natural Resource Management are encouraged to apply.
The successful candidate will join an active multidisciplinary research programme focused on understanding the ecological, biological, nutritional and conservation factors regulating African wildlife populations, with particular emphasis on large herbivores, habitat utilisation, wildlife monitoring, sustainable rangeland management and evidence-based conservation planning.
The fellowship provides an opportunity for a talented doctoral graduate to gain advanced research, teaching and postgraduate supervision experience under the mentorship of established researchers while contributing to internationally recognised research programmes.
The fellowship will be awarded on a competitive basis, considering applicants' academic achievements, publication record, teaching experience, supervisory experience and research potential. The fellowship is available for a period of one year and is renewable annually for up to three years, subject to satisfactory performance and the submission of annual progress reports.
Duties and responsibilities:
•    Conduct innovative research in wildlife science, wildlife management and conservation biology.
•    Contribute to research on wildlife monitoring, habitat assessment, sustainable rangeland management, conservation planning and large herbivore ecology.
•    Utilise modern technologies including GPS telemetry, GIS, remote sensing, drones and artificial intelligence within wildlife research programmes.
•    Publish a minimum of two peer-reviewed scientific papers per year.
•    Present research findings at national and international scientific conferences.
•    Assist with undergraduate teaching and practical training in Wildlife Science and Wildlife Management.
•    Assist with the supervision and mentoring of Honours, MSc and PhD students.
•    Contribute to curriculum enhancement and module development.
•    Assist with grant applications and research project development.
•    Register and reside as a postdoctoral fellow at the University of the Free State and participate in relevant activities of the Directorate of Research and Postgraduate Studies.
Job Requirements:
Eligibility criteria
•    Open to all South African and foreign nationals for full-time research at the University of the Free State.
•    Hold a PhD degree in Wildlife Science, Wildlife Management, Conservation Biology, Ecology, Zoology, Rangeland Science, Animal Science or a closely related discipline.
•    Have obtained their doctoral degree within the last five years.
•    Demonstrate a publication record in peer-reviewed scientific journals.
•    Have experience in wildlife research and field-based ecological studies
•    Demonstrate experience in undergraduate teaching and practical training.
•    Demonstrate the ability to contribute to curriculum development and postgraduate supervision.
•    Possess excellent scientific writing and communication skills.
•    Hold a valid driver's licence (attach a copy).
•    Successful applicants may not hold full-time salaried employment during the fellowship period.
•    Successful applicants must be willing to relocate to Bloemfontein and participate fully in departmental research, teaching and postgraduate activities.
Application:
To apply, please email the following documentation by 21 August 2026 to Prof Francois Deacon at deaconf@ufs.ac.za. Late applications will not be considered.
•    Motivation letter detailing research experience, teaching experience, publication record and suitability for the fellowship.
•    Full Curriculum Vitae, including a list of publications, conference presentations and other scholarly outputs.
•    Full academic transcripts and copy of doctoral degree certificate.
•    Copy of ID document or passport.
•    Contact details of three academic referees.
Value of the fellowship:
•    R 270,000 annual fellowship.
•    R 30,000 additional research expenses fund.
Closing date:
21 August 2026
Commencement of fellowship:
01 January 2027

Role Overview The Logistics Coordinator is a pivotal role within the business, responsible for the end-to-end coordination of magnetite product movements from mine gate in South Africa through to final delivery at international destinations. Operating at the intersection of operations, finance, and commercial, the successful candidate will ensure that product flows efficiently, documentation is accurate, and all stakeholders — from mine producers to international shipping partners are kept informed and aligned throughout the logistics chain.
This role demands a proactive, detail-oriented professional who thrives in a multi stakeholder environment and is comfortable managing competing priorities across time zones, currencies, and regulatory frameworks.
Responsibilities:
Mine & Producer Liaison:
Maintain regular communication with mine producers and export agents to confirm scheduled loadings, dispatch dates and product availability.
Coordinate product grade and quality requirements against customer specifications and offtake agreement parameters.
Manage daily and weekly production and dispatch schedules, escalating deviations to the Operations Manager promptly.
Maintain an up-to-date mine-to-port tracker covering all active shipments
Transport & Domestic Logistics:
Engage and manage approved domestic transport contractors (road haulage and rail) for the movement of magnetite product.
Issue transport instructions, confirm bookings and monitor vehicle/wagon movements in real time.
Investigate and resolve transport delays, shortfalls, and quality discrepancies in transit.
Track and reconcile truck and rail tonnages against dispatch and receipt records.
Export Documentation & Compliance:
Prepare, review and submit all required export documentation in accordance with South African customs (SARS) and international trade regulations.
Coordinate with freight forwarders and clearing agents to ensure timeous clearance at loading ports.
Maintain a document tracking register ensuring all originals and copies are filed and accessible for audit purposes.
Stay current with SARS, ITAC and port authority regulatory changes affecting magnetite export.
International Shipping Management:
Coordinate cargo bookings with international shipping lines and freight forwarders; confirm vessel nominations and sailing schedules.
Liaise with port agents at loading and discharge ports to manage vessel operations and demurrage exposure.
Monitor vessel ETDs, ETAs and notify all relevant parties of changes affecting downstream logistics.
Review and negotiate freight rates in conjunction with the commercial team; maintain a freight rate and surcharge register.
Track and resolve any claims arising from cargo damage, short-landing or contamination.
Laboratory & Quality Coordination:
Engage accredited laboratory services for independent survey and sampling of magnetite product at load and discharge ports.
Obtain and distribute Certificates of Analysis, surveyor reports and weight certificates to customers, finance teams and internal stakeholders.
Proactively flag quality deviations against offtake agreement specifications and support any claims resolution process.
Maintain a quality results database linked to shipment records.
Finance & Treasury Interface:
Provide logistics cost data (freight, transport, port charges, laboratory fees) to the finance team for accurate accrual and invoice processing.
Review and approve third-party freight and logistics invoices against agreed rates and confirmed quantities.
Support the treasury function with shipping documentation required for foreign currency payments and letters of credit.
Coordinate intercompany logistics cost allocations between South African, Mauritius, and other group entities.
Assist in reconciling logistics costs against standard costs and flagging variances to the cost accounting team.
Reporting & Systems Administration;
Maintain Sage ERP with accurate and timely capture of despatch, receipt and cost transactions related to logistics.
Produce weekly and monthly logistics reports including shipment status, cost summaries and KPI dashboards for management.
Update internal trackers for vessel nominations, document status, payment milestones and claims.
Support internal and external audit processes by maintaining a complete and organised document archive.
Contribute to continuous improvement of logistics processes, systems and reporting tools.

Job Description:
Key Responsibilities
Technical Inspection and Repairs
• Inspect returned products and perform technical fault diagnosis
• Repair products where possible and determine root cause of failure
• Evaluate product failures and provide detailed technical reports
• Assist with technical evaluation of new products and NRCS compliance requirements
• Support NRCS certification testing processes
Field Support, Site Inspection and Technical Reporting
• Attend installation sites where Spazio products are installed, when required
• Inspect installed lighting fittings, drivers, wiring, and associated components
• Identify and diagnose installation faults, product faults, electrical supply issues, or external causes
• Assess installation quality and compliance with product specifications and electrical standards
• Identify incorrect installation practices that may affect product performance or safety
• Take photographic evidence and maintain accurate records during site inspections
• Prepare clear, accurate, and professional technical reports outlining findings, root cause, and recommendations
• Provide technical reports to management and clients to support technical decisions and warranty evaluations
• Complete all call out reports accurately and maintain detailed records
• Represent Spazio Lighting professionally when interacting with clients, contractors, consultants, and electricians onsite
• Support the technical team with technical reports and customer assistance
Return and Inventory Management
• Manage and control returned stock inventory accurately
• Ensure proper logging, tracking, and processing of returns

Role Overview
The Service Manager – MSP is responsible for overseeing the operational health, service delivery, and customer experience across managed cloud environments within a Managed Services Provider (MSP) environment. The role sits at the intersection of technical delivery, people leadership, and commercial accountability, ensuring customers receive proactive, reliable, and value-driven cloud operations services. The successful candidate will lead engineering delivery teams, manage client relationships, and ensure operational excellence across cloud infrastructure, service management, and delivery governance.
Role breakdown 50% Technical / 50% People Management (Customer & Engineering Delivery Team)
Core Purpose:
To ensure uptime, performance, and value delivery across our clients’ cloud environments through a structured, proactive, and people-led approach — all while delivering a unified, seamless experience as One Synthesis Team

• Oversee day-to-day operations of customer cloud environments and managed services platforms.

• Drive operational activities including patching, backups, disaster recovery, and platform reliability initiatives.
• Monitor cloud cost performance, budget utilisation, and optimisation opportunities across client environments.

• Coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure delivery timelines and operational dependencies are effectively managed.
• Drive customer satisfaction and ensure a seamless end-to-end service experience.
• Track and manage multiple client budgets to avoid operational leakage and ensure commercial sustainability.
• Monitor engineer utilisation and alignment to contracted customer scope and service agreements.
• Forecast delivery capacity, identify operational risks early, and implement proactive mitigation plans.
• Collaborate with leadership teams to support sustainable growth and operational excellence initiatives.
Essential Skills & Experience
• Strong experience in Managed Services Provider (MSP) operations or cloud service delivery environments.
• Hands-on understanding of AWS cloud infrastructure and cloud-native operations.
• Strong understanding of infrastructure operations, cloud systems, and operational service management.
• Experience managing incident response, operational support, and SLA-driven service environments.
• Strong customer relationship management and stakeholder engagement skills.
• Experience leading engineering delivery teams and coordinating cross-functional operational activities.
